pipelines.name: Build

steps.name: Publish project
steps.run:
dotnet publish -c "Release" -o obj/build-output/publish
cd obj/build-output/publish
zip -r KeyConnector.zip .
mv KeyConnector.zip ../../../

steps.name: Build custom image metadata
steps.run:
{
  echo "items<<METADATA_EOF"
  echo "org.opencontainers.image.title=Bitwarden Key Connector"
  echo "org.opencontainers.image.vendor=Bitwarden Inc."
  echo "org.opencontainers.image.url=https://bitwarden.com"
  echo "org.opencontainers.image.version=${IMAGE_TAG}"
  echo "org.opencontainers.image.revision=${REVISION}"
  echo "com.bitwarden.project=${_PROJECT_NAME}"
  echo "METADATA_EOF"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Sign image with Cosign
steps.run:
IFS=',' read -r -a tags_array <<< "${TAGS}"
images=()
for tag in "${tags_array[@]}"; do
  images+=("${tag}@${DIGEST}")
done
cosign sign --yes "${images[@]}"

pipelines.name: Cleanup Container Images

steps.name: Delete container image version
steps.run:
# Get the version ID for this specific tag
VERSION_ID=$(gh api \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
  "/orgs/bitwarden/packages/container/key-connector/versions" \
  --jq ".[] | select(.metadata.container.tags[] == \"$IMAGE_TAG\") | .id" \
  | head -1)

if [[ -n "$VERSION_ID" ]]; then
  echo "Deleting image with tag: $IMAGE_TAG (version ID: $VERSION_ID)"
  gh api \
    --method DELETE \
    -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
    "/orgs/bitwarden/packages/container/key-connector/versions/$VERSION_ID"
  echo "Successfully deleted image"
else
  echo "No image found with tag: $IMAGE_TAG"
fi

pipelines.name: Bump version

steps.name: Set up Git
steps.run:
git config --local user.email "178206702+bw-ghapp[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git config --local user.name "bw-ghapp[bot]"

steps.name: Install xmllint
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y libxml2-utils

steps.name: Verify input version
steps.run:
# Error if version has not changed.
if [[ "$NEW_VERSION" == "$CURRENT_VERSION" ]]; then
  echo "Version has not changed."
  exit 1
fi

# Check if version is newer.
if printf '%s\n' "${CURRENT_VERSION}" "${NEW_VERSION}" | sort -C -V; then
  echo "Version check successful."
else
  echo "Version check failed."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Bump version props for version override
Bump version props with automatic calculation
Set final version output
steps.run:
if [[ "${_BUMP_VERSION_OVERRIDE_OUTCOME}" == "success" ]]; then
  echo "version=${_INPUT_VERSION_NUMBER_OVERRIDE}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
elif [[ "${_BUMP_VERSION_AUTOMATIC_OUTCOME}" == "success" ]]; then
  echo "version=${_CALCULATE_NEXT_VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Check if version changed
steps.run:
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  echo "changes_to_commit=TRUE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "changes_to_commit=FALSE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "No changes to commit!";
fi
